notes.title: 0.7.0.9 Update Note
notes.notes:
1. The strategic mode that was removed due to the art update has been restored. It is now called the New Colony Continent and can be entered through the pier lighthouse in the Old Colony.
2. Fixed the bug of missing English instructions in some novice guidance tasks.

notes.title: 0.7.0.7 Update Note
notes.notes:
1.Added the ground display effect when the weather changes to rain and snow.
2.New workbench stone mill, which can grind items.
3.The new cash crop, sugarcane, can be used to produce sugar using stone mills. The molasses, a byproduct obtained randomly during the sugar-making process, can be used to make rum in fermentation barrels.
3.Temporarily removed the windmill, now requires the use of a stone mill to produce flour.
4.The new workbench fermentation barrel can use a container to add water and put in molasses for fermentation. After fermentation is complete, rum can be produced.

notes.title: 0.7.0.6 Update Note
notes.notes:
0.7.0.6
The combat system has been updated, and only unarmed attack tests are available. 
1.You can choose to use different routines and moves.
2.A new type of equipment, the combat chip, can enhance combat attributes.
3.New items, combat data. Can upgrade the level of combat chips.
